title: New review explores how faint ‘glow’ from plants could transform global monitoring of photosynthesis
summary_en: New work co-written by a University of Kansas researcher examines how solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence can help scientists measure photosynthetic activity, connecting processes inside individual plant cells with observations of entire ecosystems from space.
